about: A MADE-UP SECOND COUNTRY (never shipped: it lives under tools/fixtures/, outside data/settings/curriculum/, and only tools/one-curriculum.js reads it). It proves a country is one file: three nodes, each citing its document, the two sub-topics mapped to three existing skills of data/settings/qgen.json; the check adds it beside the live files and sees its questions, tags and Find topics follow with nothing else changed.
